scope: Actual API, supervisor, worker and SQLite; local isolated cloud-style configuration

checks.name: Authenticated cloud runtime and Secure session cookie
Engine continues with SSE closed and no HTTP requests
Training worker executes with browser/SSE disconnected
Server restart preserves SQLite, master-key, saved settings and encrypted data
Stopped engine remains healthy; no configured providers or transactions

limitations: Does not validate Render provisioning, proxy TLS/SSE behavior, live providers, trading performance or 24-hour uptime. Secure cookie is inspected over loopback HTTP, not tested by a browser.
